info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Tennant Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API enables the creation and management of detailed information for Tennant recliners within the catalog. Businesses can utilize this endpoint to add new product specifications, tailored descriptions, and pricing details. Typically, product managers and inventory systems will interact with this API to ensure their catalog remains up-to-date and reflective of current offerings. The API streamlines the process of catalog management, enhancing the efficiency of inventory workflows in the retail and e-commerce sectors.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for tennant recliners. By sending a POST request with the necessary information, you can successfully log details specific to a tennant's recliner, making it easier to manage resources and personalizations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for a tenant recliner operation. It includes necessary fields that capture the specific requirements and configurations for the tenant recliner.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the details of the tennant recliner.

CreateCatalogTennantReclinerDetailReques.title: Tennant Recliner Details Request

tennant_recliner_id.description: The unique identifier for the Tennant recliner.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of the Tennant recliners requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Tennant recliner.
